comparison.objective: Restock two amenity trays to exact par while leaving surplus on the cart; candidate removes tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Inventory-aware pick-place, cross-arm handoff, and orientation placement versus precision bimanual impact tooling and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Each tray has exactly one flat soap and one upright shampoo, with spare stock retained; explicit pose tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four fractures and exact fragment accounting.
comparison.reason: Both account for multiple objects, but inventory placement does not test fracture, force regulation, or retained-insert integrity.
